bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 PM PST THIS EVENING... Combined seas 10 to 12 ft. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 615 PM Friday, and 700 AM and 715 PM on Saturday. The Friday evening ebb will be very strong. The Saturday evening ebb will be strong.
bar.ebb: evening ebb will be very strong
